title: Pre-Earnings Positioning Is Key
summary: Yesterday afternoon featured three potentially significant market-moving events. The first was the FOMC meeting, which turned out to be a relative non-event. The committee kept rates unchanged despite two dissents, and Chair Warsh’s press conference lacked fireworks. Markets finished the session roughly where they were before the decision. The fireworks came after the close when Microsoft (MSFT) and Alphabet (GOOGL, GOOG) reported. Investors initially liked the former but immediately hated the latter. The reactions tell us much about investor thinking and positioning.
